matrix._comment: Levels: tuned = arch-specific kernels or default-on route; generic = runs on the portable/typed-dispatch path; none = not available. Capability, not admission or certification (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

sources.Decode: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md kernel-select layer (hipfire-dispatch / rdna-compute family tables pick WMMA -> specialized -> baseline); README GPU table
sources.Prefill WMMA: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (WMMA family tables); docs/BENCHMARKS.md supporting notes (gfx12 WMMA paths; gfx906 uses dp4a MMQ, CDNA is MFMA not WMMA)
sources.DFlash: docs/speculation-support-inventory.md (DFlash is per model arch, GPU-generic); tuned: CHANGELOG 0.4.2 gfx1100 shared rotations, gfx1151 XLDS verify GEMMs, gfx1201 continuous-batching / device accept
sources.MTP: docs/speculation-support-inventory.md (MTP per model arch); tuned: CHANGELOG 0.4.2 gfx1151 MTP cap 4 + DET prompt fill, gfx1201 batched MTP fill
sources.NPU prefill: CHANGELOG 0.4.2 Flash-Next NPU trunk route: exact gfx1151 with XDNA2 only
sources.Redline: README / docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Redline roles: RDNA1-RDNA4 dispatch; mq4r_redline_default on exact gfx1100/gfx1151/gfx1201
